glossary.definition: A neural network is a computing structure loosely inspired by neurons in the brain: layers of simple units that pass signals to each other, strengthening or weakening those connections as they learn from examples. Picture a huge grid of light switches, wired together in layers, where training slowly adjusts which switches influence which other switches until the whole grid reliably lights up the correct "answer" pattern for a given input. It's the basic architecture underneath almost all modern AI, from image recognition to language models.

items.title: Meta expands Muse to small businesses
items.summary: The move comes as agentic AI plays an increasingly big part in business operations, sparking oversight concerns.

items.title: Report: Anthropic targets pre-Thanksgiving IPO launch, despite warning of AI’s ‘existential risks’
items.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic PBC is reportedly forging ahead with its plans to go public and has set a new target date of Nov. 9, according to a report from Bloomberg that cited anonymous sources familiar with the matter — meaning shares would start trading before Thanksgiving. The company, led by its Chief Executive Dario Amodei (pictured), hopes to begin formally marketing its initial public offering by the week of Nov. 9, but internal discussions about the exact timeline are still ongoing and could yet change.

items.title: Whatever AI Safety Is, It’s Not This
items.summary: Asking AI companies to self-regulate is a great way to pretend like you’ve accomplished something. Here’s a fun history lesson for you. Don’t worry, we’ll make it quick! In 1966, nearly 51,000 people died on US highways. The overwhelming evidence suggested that many lives could have been saved with modern seat belts , which by then had been around for several years.

items.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture Venezuela’s president
items.summary: President Trump reportedly asked for Grok's opinion before invading Venezuela and capturing Nicolás Maduro. S. invaded Venezuela and captured its president, Nicolás Maduro, President Trump had a secret meeting with Elon Musk, Time magazine reports. This was roughly seven months after Musk left his role in the Trump administration at the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).

items.title: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
items.summary: Guided Vision is launching in Gemini Live on compatible Android devices today to use AI to give real-time audio descriptions of anything you point your phone's camera at. By sharing your camera in Gemini Live, you can have Google's AI help with things like reading small text, describing your surroundings, finding or identifying objects around you, and describing details on specific objects. Like the VoiceOver Live Recognition feature Apple has added to the iPhone and Vision Pro , it's designed for people who are blind, have low vision, or want assistance in specific situations. People with low vision can use Guided Vision to have Gemini describe what’s nearby and ask follow-up questions.

items.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library. OpenAI is again experimenting with how its conversational AI assistant, ChatGPT, can help users as they shop online. On Thursday, the company announced the global launch of two new shopping features, including a way to virtually try on clothing and accessories and a new favoriting function that can help users save products they like for later reference. The updates arrive at a time when AI assistants are exploring consumer use cases around shopping.

items.title: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
items.summary: " The AI holds video calls in real time, processing facial expressions, tone of voice, and gestures. In a Tavus study, 48 percent of participants believed Griffin was a real person after a one-minute call. Previous systems maxed out at two percent. Tavus has introduced Griffin, what the company calls the first "Human Interaction Model" (HIM), a class of model designed to understand and carry on face-to-face conversations in real time.

items.title: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews
items.summary: A federal judge has dismissed a pair of antitrust lawsuits filed by Chegg and Rolling Stone parent company Penske Media Corporation, which accused Google of driving away web traffic with its AI-powered search features, as reported earlier by Reuters . US District Judge Amit Mehta takes Google's side in a ruling on Wednesday , writing that PMC and Chegg's claims don't stand up to antitrust law. In lawsuits filed last year, Chegg and PMC accused Google of abusing its monopoly power by coercing publishers into supplying content for AI Overviews for free, or risk disappearing from search results. Rolling Stone’s parent company and Chegg claimed Google’s AI search features drove away traffic from their sites.

items.title: With most information hidden, the game Stratego had stumped AI—until now
items.summary: Deep Blue took down Garry Kasparov at chess in 1997, AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol at Go in 2016, and poker bots have been beating professionals for years. But one classic game called Stratego held out. Even DeepMind, with its exceptional budget, couldn't build a machine that reliably beat the best human players. Now, a team of researchers from Carnegie Mellon, MIT, New York University, and Stanford University has done it.

items.title: RFK Jr. thinks AI will free us from the "tyranny" of medical facts, expertise
items.summary: At a Make America Healthy Again event Tuesday, anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy opened a "fireside chat" with Vice President JD Vance on the topic of artificial intelligence. " Kennedy boasted that the Trump administration is "making it easy for every American to use AI," which he claimed would free us from the "medical tyranny" of doctors and health experts. " He also suggested that the technology would confirm his misinformation about vaccines and contrarian views on public health guidance.

items.title: Show colleagues how much you care by sending an AI avatar to your Google Meet call
items.summary: If you've always wanted to say you have "people" to attend your meetings, there's an app in development for that, as long as you're comfortable with the idea of eventually sending an AI bot in your place and potentially offending your human colleagues. MeetTwins, from Indian developer Aditya Shinde, is an AI assistant currently recruiting users for its beta. It's designed for a single purpose: to attend Google Meet calls on behalf of its operator and relay approved information to colleagues without requiring its human to spend precious time actually speaking to coworkers. Shinde describes the tool on its website as being inspired by his own desire to send an AI bot to his Google Meet calls, an idea he instead decided to develop into an actual product built using AI models from India-based AI firm Sarvam, and with the ability to add a digital twin avatar created by Simli.

items.title: “We’re not going to shoot ourselves in the foot” over hack fallout, says OpenAI’s chief research officer
items.summary: Two months after the bombshell news that a swarm of its agents had broken their containment and hacked into the computers of the AI company Hugging Face , OpenAI is still putting out fires. A steady drip of disclosures about other hacks in the weeks since has kept OpenAI in the spotlight and raised serious questions about the safety of its technology. Last week brought news of another hack, this time into Australia’s national health-care system. The Australian government says that OpenAI did not notify it of the breach until 84 days after it happened.
